Risk Scenario: Terminated employees retain active accounts and application access after their last working day, enabling post-employment data access or malicious action.
Existing Controls: Manual HR email to service desk; disable performed on best effort
Treatment Summary: Automate leaver deprovisioning from HR source of authority with same-day disable, session revocation and 30-day account retention before deletion.
Entra Capability: Entra Connect / HR-driven provisioning, Lifecycle Workflows

Risk Scenario: Permanent standing Global Administrator and Privileged Role Administrator assignments increase the blast radius of any single credential compromise.
Existing Controls: Admin accounts exist as separate identities; no PIM
Treatment Summary: Convert standing assignments to PIM eligible with approval, justification, MFA on activation and maximum 4-hour elevation. Reduce permanent Global Admins to two break-glass identities.
Entra Capability: Entra ID Governance - Privileged Identity Management

Risk Scenario: Contractors retain access beyond engagement end dates because no contract end date is held against the identity and no owner is accountable for closure.
Existing Controls: Manager verbally notifies service desk at end of engagement
Treatment Summary: Mandatory sponsor and expiry date on every non-employee identity; automated expiry with 14-day sponsor re-attestation via entitlement management access packages.
Entra Capability: Entra ID Governance - Entitlement Management, access package expiry

Risk Scenario: Users accumulate entitlements after internal transfers because access is added at the new role and never removed from the previous one.
Treatment Summary: Mover event triggers role-based access recalculation and manager re-certification of retained entitlements within 10 business days.
Entra Capability: Lifecycle Workflows, dynamic group membership, access reviews

Risk Scenario: Critical applications (SAP, Dynamics 365, quality system) undergo no periodic access certification, so inappropriate entitlements persist indefinitely and cannot be evidenced to auditors.
Existing Controls: Ad hoc review by application owners at unpredictable intervals
Treatment Summary: Quarterly access certification for Tier 1 applications with named application owners, auto-revoke on non-response and exception register.

Risk Scenario: MFA is not consistently enforced. Coverage gaps exist for service accounts, contractors and legacy client access, allowing credential-only authentication to reach corporate data.
Existing Controls: MFA enabled per-user for approximately 70 percent of employees; no policy-based enforcement
Treatment Summary: Conditional Access policy enforcing MFA for all users and all cloud apps, with phishing-resistant methods mandated for privileged roles and finance. Report-only piloting then enforcement.
Entra Capability: Conditional Access, Authentication Methods policy, Authentication Strengths

Risk Scenario: Legacy authentication protocols remain permitted, providing a route that bypasses Conditional Access and MFA entirely.
Treatment Summary: Block legacy authentication via Conditional Access after 90-day sign-in log analysis and remediation of the four dependent service accounts identified.

Risk Scenario: Workload identities - including two Copilot agents and four Power Platform service principals - hold broad, unreviewed Microsoft Graph application permissions granted during a pilot and never revisited.
Existing Controls: Admin consent required for new grants; no review of existing grants
Treatment Summary: Inventory all workload identities with owner and business justification; revoke unused permissions to least privilege; apply Conditional Access for workload identities. Full lifecycle governance deferred pending Workload Identities Premium licensing.
Entra Capability: App registrations, Graph permission review, Workload Identity Federation

Risk Scenario: Guest and B2B partner accounts have no expiry, no sponsor and no periodic review, so external access persists after collaboration ends.
Treatment Summary: Guest access governed through access packages with sponsor, expiry and semi-annual review; dormant guests over 90 days auto-removed.
Entra Capability: Entitlement Management, Access Reviews for guests

Risk Scenario: Emergency break-glass accounts are undocumented, unmonitored and have never been tested, risking either lockout during an incident or undetected misuse.
Existing Controls: Two accounts believed to exist; credentials location unclear
Treatment Summary: Formally define two cloud-only break-glass accounts excluded from CA, with FIDO2 keys in physical custody, alerting on any sign-in, and semi-annual tested use.
Entra Capability: Conditional Access exclusions, sign-in alerting via Log Analytics

Risk Scenario: Shared and service accounts authenticate with static passwords that are not rotated, are known to multiple staff and cannot be attributed to an individual.
Existing Controls: Passwords stored in a shared vault
Treatment Summary: Migrate to managed identities or workload identity federation where the application supports it; where it does not, apply vaulted rotation and named accountable owner.

Risk Scenario: Access to critical applications is permitted from unmanaged and non-compliant devices, so a compromised personal endpoint yields a valid session to finance data.
Existing Controls: Intune deployed but compliance not enforced as an access condition
Treatment Summary: Conditional Access requiring compliant or hybrid-joined device for Tier 1 applications, with a scoped exception process for partner access via application protection policy.
Entra Capability: Conditional Access - device compliance grant control

Risk Scenario: Segregation of Duties conflicts within finance entitlements - notably vendor creation combined with payment release - are not detected or reported.
Existing Controls: Manual review at year-end audit only
Treatment Summary: Define an SoD conflict matrix for finance roles, encode as mutually exclusive access packages, and report violations quarterly to the CFO and internal audit.
Entra Capability: Entitlement Management - separation of duties on access packages

Risk Scenario: Identity log retention is insufficient to reconstruct an access event beyond 30 days, limiting incident investigation and audit evidence.
Treatment Summary: Route sign-in, audit and provisioning logs to Log Analytics with 12-month retention; build KRI workbook and alert rules for privileged activity.
Entra Capability: Diagnostic settings to Log Analytics, Entra workbooks
